name: Masonry
description: Modular brick veneer with ties, 8 in and 12 in concrete block walls with joint reinforcement, through-wall flashing and weeps, loose lintels and adhered stone veneer. Units and mortar follow from the module geometry. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: Technical Note 10, Dimensioning and Estimating Brick Masonry
International Residential Code, Section R703 Exterior Covering (water-resistive barrier, siding attachment, anchored veneer ties)
TMS 402/602, Building Code Requirements and Specification for Masonry Structures
Plain geometry: the quantity follows from the measured length, height or area and the stated module (no outside source needed)
TEK notes: concrete masonry unit sizes (nominal 8 x 8 x 16 in, actual 7-5/8 x 7-5/8 x 15-5/8 in)
ASTM A615/A615M, Standard Specification for Deformed and Plain Carbon-Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement (nominal bar weights)
The product data sheet of the coating, adhesive or product you specify (spread rate, coverage, coats)

assume: Brick: modular, 6.75 per SF with 3/8 in joints (BIA Technical Note 10), 5% waste.
Mortar: 0.0592 CF per SF from the joint volume, plus 25% for waste and droppings (a starting figure).
Ties: one per 2.67 SF of wall (IRC R703.8.4.1 limit).
No deduction for openings: draw them as cut-outs.
items.note: Measure the veneer area on the elevations. Metric twin: the same US modular brick; local bricks differ in size, so change 72.66 for yours.
items.name: Brick veneer, modular, 3/8 in joints, with ties

assume: Block: 1.125 per SF on a 16 x 8 in module, 5% waste.
Mortar: face-shell bedding, 1.25 in shells, 3/8 in joints = 0.01442 CF per SF, plus 25% for waste (a starting figure).
Ladder joint reinforcement every second course (16 in): 0.75 LF per SF, 10% for laps.
Grout and vertical bars are per the drawings: add them as their own items.
items.note: Measure the wall area on the elevations.
items.name: Concrete block wall 8 in, face-shell bedding, joint reinforcement 16 in o.c.
